source._comment: www.elections.ny.gov: Cloudflare browser challenge on every page (HTTP 403 to scripts; not worked around). data.ny.gov: no early-voting dataset. Stand-in since 2026-10-26: UF Election Lab NY rows (US.csv + NY_county.csv), 'Data provided by the New York State Board of Elections' -- per the Lab, the daily report is a cumulative county total of in-person early voters only (no party, mail or demographics). NYC BOE (vote.nyc) covers only the five NYC counties. Early voting runs Oct 24 - Nov 1.
